entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Regression: projection casts between CLR types sharing a store type fail on EF Core 11 #39782
    11.0.2
  • Null element in JSON complex collection fails with "Invalid token type: 'Null'" when querying #39781
    12.0.0
  • Null element in complex collection fails in SaveChanges with "The property ... belongs to the type ..., but is being used with an instance of type ..." when the element type has a collection property #39780
    12.0.0

Closed

  • EF Core 11 regression: A nested JSON complex collection projection with identity resolution is rejected #39733
    12.0-preview1
  • Do not generate Convert node in SQL if the converted store type is identical to the operand's #26411
    12.0-preview1
  • Simplification of Count(*) with multiple group by can generate wrong result #27130
    12.0-preview1
  • Bundle-Migration errors with "cannot access file...being used by another process" #25555
    12.0-preview1
  • MinBy_over_subquery specification test is nondeterministic (tie in Northwind data) #39613
    11.0.2
  • EFX — Write Less Build More #39569
    Discussions
  • Union in collection subquery cannot be translated #34849
    12.0-preview1
  • SaveChangesFailed interceptor is skipped when automatic change detection throws #39757
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • Reset the pending indent in IndentedStringBuilder.Clear #39795
    community-contribution
  • Throw the enum conversion error for out-of-range numeric strings #39794
    community-contribution
  • Only apply SqliteParameter.Size to string and binary values #39793
    community-contribution
  • Support nullable enums in SqliteDataReader.GetFieldValue<T> #39792
    community-contribution
  • Don't lose a millisecond when binding DateTime and TimeOnly as REAL in Microsoft.Data.Sqlite #39791
    community-contribution
  • Translate more SQL Server COALESCE expressions to ISNULL safely #39790
    area-harness
  • Translate JSON_VALUE, JSON_QUERY and json_extract #39789
  • Avoid repeated nullable scalar subqueries in comparisons #39788
  • [release/11.0] Fix full-text catalog migration scaffolding #39787
  • [release/11.0] Allow changing CLR type without SQL conversion #39786
  • Scaffold against a new snapshot instance when the shared one is finalized #39784
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39783
  • Bump System.CommandLine from 2.0.13 to 3.0.0 #39773
    area-infrastructure
  • Bump OpenTelemetry.Exporter.InMemory from 1.20.0 to 1.21.0 #39770
    area-infrastructure
  • Don't validate JSON complex collections for identity resolution ordering #39779
    community-contribution
  • Resolve grouping aggregates to the query SQL evaluates them in #39451
    community-contribution
  • Discover the migrations-bundle DbContext out-of-process so publish doesn't lock the assembly #38456
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • Make MinBy over subquery test deterministic #39718
  • Fix SQL Server JSON_CONTAINS type handling #39706
    area-harness
  • Skip Cosmos add conflict session token test on Linux emulator #39776
  • [release/10.0]: Bump StyleCop.Analyzers from 1.1.118 to 1.3.180 #39725
    area-infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39746
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39765
    12.0-preview1
  • Fix #34849: Union in collection subquery cannot be translated #39726
    community-contribution
  • Raise SaveChangesFailed when DetectChanges throws during SaveChanges #39762
    community-contribution

Updated

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39747
  • Fix collection Contains normalization element type and overload matching (#39329) #39359
    community-contribution
  • Fix MinBy/MaxBy null-key handling with index-friendly selection #39653
    community-contribution
  • Ignore constraint operations on tables being dropped in SQLite migrations (#39761) #39768
    community-contribution
  • Count NULL as a value in Distinct().Count() over a grouping #39766
    community-contribution
  • Add model-wide and member JSON reader/writer configuration #39483
    api-review
  • Fix JSON_CONTAINS for nested JSON documents #39715
    area-harness
  • Bump SQLite3MC.PCLRaw.bundle from 2.7.0 to 2.7.1 #39771
    area-infrastructure
  • Translate primitive collections projected through set operations #39561
    community-contribution
  • Implement EF.Functions.IsJson #39749
    community-contribution
  • Translate more DateOnly/TimeOnly members on SQLite #39748
    community-contribution
  • Bind complex properties over single-result subqueries #39763
    community-contribution
  • Update StyleCop.Analyzers to 1.3.180 #39753
  • [release/11.0] Preserve null compensation for JSON complex properties in left joins #39751
  • [release/11.0] Prevent data loss when DetectChanges runs before saving JSON complex collections #39778
  • [release/11.0] Fix repeated full-text index migrations with UseLanguage #39752
